title: Region × channel combinations with >50% H1 revenue growth
prompt: For each region and channel combination, compare completed-order revenue in the first half of 2024 to the first half of 2025. Which combinations grew by more than 50%?
population: Completed orders (and their order_items) placed in H1 2024 (Jan–Jun) or H1 2025 (Jan–Jun), joined to customer region.
grain: order_item → region × channel × half-year revenue → pivoted region × channel with both halves as columns → final: filtered result.
metricDefinition: H1 revenue growth rate = (H1 2025 revenue − H1 2024 revenue) / H1 2024 revenue, per region × channel combination, filtered to > 50% growth.
transformationPlan: aggregate completed-order revenue (via order_items) to region × channel × half-year
pivot into H1 2024 and H1 2025 columns per region × channel using conditional aggregation
referenceSql: WITH rev AS (SELECT c.region, o.channel, CASE WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-07-01' THEN 'h1_2024' WHEN o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01' THEN 'h1_2025' END AS half, sum(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND ((o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2024-07-01') OR (o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-07-01')) GROUP BY c.region, o.channel, half), pivoted AS (SELECT region, channel, max(revenue) FILTER (WHERE half = 'h1_2024') AS h1_2024_revenue, max(revenue) FILTER (WHERE half = 'h1_2025') AS h1_2025_revenue FROM rev GROUP BY region, channel) SELECT region, channel, h1_2024_revenue, h1_2025_revenue, (h1_2025_revenue - h1_2024_revenue) / h1_2024_revenue AS growth_rate FROM pivoted WHERE h1_2024_revenue IS NOT NULL AND h1_2025_revenue IS NOT NULL AND (h1_2025_revenue - h1_2024_revenue) / h1_2024_revenue > 0.5
